limitations: Risk thresholds and coverage thresholds are separate predeclared comparison tracks; coverage-track policies do not enforce a risk limit.
Coverage targets are matched only on calibration where attainable; actual test/OOD coverage is reported and never retuned.
One percent target concerns absent-family any-accept events, not conditional error among accepted candidates.
Foundation model overlap with public ABO is unknown; campaign split independence does not establish pretraining decontamination.
Disagreement may reflect correlated model errors; agreement is not truth or physical identity.
New-view recommendations have no observed second-view outcome; no benefit, latency or saved calls of active sensing is established.
The selected SigLIP hybrid comes from its prior dev-only selection; no winner is selected using this test/OOD report.

protocol.absent_error_scope: ANY acceptance across all query variants within each absent family
protocol.agreement: DINO_top1 == dev_selected_SigLIP_hybrid_top1 == RRF_top1; exact product, not family
protocol.present_error_scope: ALL query rows plus any error within each family
